activity_summary: Alone after dinner you hummed the anthem and lost it. You said four voices that do not tell each other what they mean would be a scene, and that it is not a scene yet. You split the month into what must be done and what you would only like to better, and you struck the second.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Hummed, lost the phrase, and cut the list in two.
